description: jmap-server/helpers.rs implements civil_from_days using Howard Hinnant's algorithm rather than using the time or chrono crate. The implementation appears correct for the tested cases, but: (1) it uses SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default() — if the system clock is before 1970 (common in containers with clock drift during start), duration_since returns Err and the default of 0 seconds silently produces 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z rather than failing loudly; (2) the custom code is a maintenance surface — any contributor touching helpers.rs must understand Hinnant's algorithm to review changes. The time crate is already in the Rust ecosystem and handles all of this.
title: now_utc_string rolls custom calendar — maintenance burden and edge cases
